projects.name: Tallmadge (clpr)
projects.tagline: Package manager & environment switcher for AI coding agents
projects.description: Installs plugins into a global store, selectively activates skills, agents, and MCP servers into ~/.agents/, composes AGENTS.md and mcp.json, and bridges thirteen coding harnesses — with switchable profiles on top.

projects.name: Clothesline
projects.tagline: Durable local messaging between coding agents
projects.description: A local message bus for coding agents: agents announce presence, open conversations, and exchange messages that stay retained and keyword-searchable until you delete the database. A read-only browser shows who's online and what was said.

projects.name: Setauket
projects.tagline: Local, cross-harness memory for coding agents
projects.description: A local context store for coding-agent sessions: submitted turns stay searchable for three days, then get summarized; decisions and preferences remain versioned until explicitly superseded. Search is keyword and semantic, all on your machine.
